plugins.name: agile-sprint-drain
plugins.description: Sprint-drain orchestrator for Claude Code — runs the active sprint to a fixed point by auto-alternating agile-10-implement (build queue) and agile-11-merge-train (merge queue) until the Jira dependency graph is fully resolved. An actionable-work guard keeps retrying while any item can advance and stops with a report only when every remaining item is human-blocked. Requires the agile-execution and agile-merge-review plugins installed. Needs the gh CLI + Atlassian MCP.

plugins.name: agile-sprint-drain
plugins.description: Alternate implementation and merge workflows until an active sprint is drained or blocked.

skills.name: agile-sprint-drain
skills.description: Drain the active sprint to a fixed point: auto-alternate agile-10-implement (build) and agile-11-merge-train (merge) until both empty (DRAINED) or blocked (STUCK). Optional concurrency=N, dispatch=session. Triggers: drain the sprint, run the sprint to completion, implement and merge until done, clear the whole board, ship the sprint.
headings: Audit-trail gate — a ticket is drained only if it can say how it shipped
Work discovered mid-phase — do it, or ticket it properly
skills.description_zh: 交替运行 agile-10-implement 实现与 agile-11-merge-train 合并，直到当前冲刺两端都清空（DRAINED）或受阻（STUCK）。支持 concurrency=N 与 dispatch=session，适用于持续实现合并、清空看板和完成冲刺。

headings: The loop (one **pass** per iteration; recomputed from the live board each time)
Eligibility & merged signal (mirrors the real sub-skills)
